Overview

La Romana is a city in 12 with a population of 250,000. A southeastern city known for its sugar industry, luxury resorts, and the famous Altos de Chavón village. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
